title: David Chosen to Be King
lines: David was a shepherd who lived in Israel.
大衛是個牧羊人，住在以色列。
Israel became a great nation that was ruled by judges, men and women who helped the people follow God.
以色列成為一個偉大的國家，由士師統治，這些男女幫助百姓跟隨神。
But the people asked for a king so they could be like the other nations.
但百姓要求立一個王，這樣他們就能像其他國家一樣。
God warned them through the prophet Samuel that a king would not be the best choice for them, but the people wanted a king anyway.
神透過先知撒母耳警告他們，立王對他們來說不是最好的選擇，但百姓仍然想要一個王。
So God chose a man named Saul and had Samuel anoint him.
於是神揀選了一個名叫掃羅的人，並讓撒母耳膏抹他。
Saul became the king of Israel.
掃羅成為了以色列的王。
Saul started out as a good king, but he started making wrong choices and did not follow God as he should.
掃羅一開始是個好王，但他開始做出錯誤的選擇，並且沒有照他所應該的那樣跟隨神。
God was sad that he made Saul king, so God sent Samuel to the house of Jesse in Bethlehem because God had chosen one of Jesse's sons to be the new king of Israel.
神因為立掃羅為王而感到憂傷，所以神差遣撒母耳去伯利恆耶西的家，因為神已經揀選了耶西的一個兒子成為以色列的新王。
Jesse's oldest son was strong and handsome.
耶西的大兒子又強壯又英俊。
Samuel thought that surely God would choose this son to be king.
撒母耳以為神肯定會揀選這個兒子作王。
But God said, "The Lord does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outside of a person, but the Lord looks at what is in the heart."
但神說：「耶和華不像人看人。人是看外貌，耶和華是看內心。」
One by one, Jesse had seven more of his sons walk in front of Samuel.
耶西讓他的另外七個兒子一個接一個地從撒母耳面前走過。
But Samuel said, "The Lord hasn't chosen any of them."
但撒母耳說：「耶和華沒有揀選他們其中任何一個。」
Samuel asked if Jesse had any other sons, and Jesse said, "My youngest son is taking care of the sheep."
撒母耳問耶西是否還有其他兒子，耶西說：「我最小的兒子正在放羊。」
Samuel asked Jesse to bring the son to him, and Jesse had David brought in from the fields.
撒母耳請耶西把這兒子帶過來，耶西就讓人把大衛從田野裡帶了進來。
God said to Samuel, "This is the one."
神對撒母耳說：「這就是那人。」
So Samuel anointed David by pouring oil on his head to show that God had chosen David to be the next king of Israel.
於是撒母耳藉著把油倒在大衛頭上來膏抹他，表明神已經揀選大衛作以色列的下一任王。
From that day on, the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully on David.
從那日起，耶和華的靈就大大感動大衛。
David went on to serve King Saul, defeat a giant with a stone and a sling, and many years later he did become king.
大衛接著去服事掃羅王，用一塊石頭和一個機弦打敗了一個巨人，多年後他確實成為了王。
David served God's purpose in his own generation.
大衛在他自己的世代服事了神的旨意。
He wasn't a perfect king, but he was a good king because he was a man after God's own heart.
他不是一個完美的王，但他是一個好王，因為他是一個合神心意的人。
